title: Mediation agency changes how labor disputes move forward
summary: The Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service says it is clarifying when it can decline to provide arbitrators, a change unions say exceeds its role.

title: Watchdog puts new numbers on the size of DOGE, but many details remain unknown as agencies refuse to turn over information
summary: In a new report, the Government Accountability Office said it was unable to verify if all Department of Government Efficiency employees completed mandatory activities intended to avoid conflicts of interest.

title: CDC gets a new chief as agency faces questions over its direction
summary: The Senate narrowly confirmed Dr. Erica Schwartz to lead the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention following a confirmation fight centered on vaccines and the future of federal public health policy.

title: Critics argue Education's latest restructuring risks something harder to replace than staff
summary: Former Education officials from both parties joined Senate Democrats in warning that moving key responsibilities to other agencies carries risks beyond staffing cuts.

title: FEMA slashed staff without considering the effects on future disaster response, watchdog reports
summary: The Government Accountability Office also found that the disaster agency is currently operating without a strategic workforce plan to determine staffing needs.

title: House probe finds gaps in U.S. effort to remove Chinese telecom risks
summary: The findings highlight the challenges agencies face in addressing national security risks embedded in complex private networks.

title: Blanche clears key hurdle in bid to lead Justice Department
summary: A pair of Republican senators moved the acting attorney general's nomination forward after securing assurances about a controversial Trump-backed “anti-weaponization” fund.

title: TSP investments continued to tumble in July
summary: Nearly all of the portfolios in the federal government’s 401(k)-style retirement savings program lost value last month.

title: GSA’s digital roadmap looks to enhance agencies’ services, CIO says
summary: Efforts to speed up adoption of new capabilities have “disrupted the longstanding practice of how technology is driven into this government,” GSA CIO Dave Shive told Nextgov/FCW.

title: LGBTQ+ feds sue to restore FEHB coverage of gender affirming care
summary: A class action lawsuit challenging the Trump administration’s campaign to block gender affirming care coverage under federal agencies’ employer-sponsored health insurance program said the move is “akin to denying continuing insulin treatment for someone with diabetes.”

title: OPM tells agencies to put tech recruiting at the center of staffing plans
summary: The guidance from the government’s HR agency also set a governmentwide goal that at least 33% of external hires be early-career workers.

title: Funding deal could spare agencies another shutdown fight
summary: The short-term spending agreement would keep the government funded through December while pausing a proposed overhaul of federal grant decisions.

title: OPM breach victims could get identity protection for life
summary: The federal government’s coverage for 22.1 million people hoovered up in the China-linked breaches is scheduled to end Sept. 30.

title: OPM finalizes rules expanding its power over RIFs, employee appeals
summary: Taken together, four regulations set for publication Monday would shift adjudication of several types of adverse action appeals from the Merit Systems Protection Board to the Office of Personnel Management.

title: Education reorganization faces bipartisan pushback, as lawmakers push to disclose price tag
summary: A department spokesperson said it was “downright malpractice” for lawmakers to reject reorganization efforts before giving them a chance to demonstrate results.

title: Survey shows the toll of USAID’s closure on former employees and their families
summary: Nearly half of survey respondents who were foreign service officers reported that their households experienced dual job loss as a result of the layoffs.

title: U.S. Digital Corps graduates largest class of fellows yet
summary: “This government has starved for talent,” OPM Director Scott Kupor said during graduation remarks.

title: Why treating everything as 'URGENT!' makes government less effective
summary: COMMENTARY | Constant urgency can feel like a mark of commitment, but leaders who know when to slow down often make better decisions, build stronger teams and deliver better results.

title: IRS could be required to publicly report wait times and backlogs
summary: A bipartisan Senate bill would create new transparency around the agency's customer service performance and expand callback options for taxpayers.

title: Why time, not timing, is the biggest retirement advantage for federal employees
summary: A look at decades of market shifts and TSP data shows the biggest driver of retirement wealth isn't picking the right stock. It's starting early, contributing consistently and letting compounding do its work.

title: CDC nominee clears key Senate hurdle despite vaccine scrutiny
summary: Dr. Erica Schwartz's nomination now heads to the full Senate after lawmakers pressed her on how she would handle political influence over the agency.
